gen-gf-bellota-gf-encode-sans: Encode Sans leaves enough gap that c never gets mistaken for o, so each line scans cleanly. And Bellota stays loud above it, its s ends hanging far from the spine.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-google-sans-flex: Stylus-drawn Bellota up top, then Google Sans Flex below with stroke ends that look cut from one ribbon. Page after page, its open curve endings keep the reading smooth.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-gruppo: Gruppo reads crisp and spacious, its curve endings never crowding one another, so lines stay light and easy to follow. Bellota above it draws every stroke with an unvarying thickness.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-inscriptiona: Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi keeps its small counters open and clear. What stands out most is the gap between the pipe-cleaner strokes of Bellota up top and that approachable, uncluttered text below.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpan: Bellota hits hard, with stems and arcs in lockstep. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded then settles into open-mouthed curves that let a block of text move smoothly from one line to the next.
gen-gf-bellota-zilla-slab: Bellota hits with heavy, unshaded strokes and an s whose ends hang far from the spine. Zilla Slab adds sturdy, technical slab-serif footing and broad openings on its curves.
gen-gf-bellota-text-clash-grotesk: Bellota Text goes open and unshaded, with nothing calligraphic to steer the eye. Clash Grotesk has no thick-and-thin modulation at all, and it matches that approachable directness line for line.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-hind: Bellota Text opens wide, with no calligraphic shading. Hind below it is a sans-serif whose taller lowercase nearly matches its capitals, with strokes as steady as a drawn string.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Bellota Text drops all calligraphic shading and leaves nothing to guide the eye, so headings land with a direct, commanding look. Pilcrow Rounded, tight-spaced and warm, reads smoothly over paragraphs.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-quicksand: Quicksand reads like blown glass bulbs on a line, with tall bowls and terminals that finish well away from the stem. Bellota Text adds a commanding, unshaded counterpoint on top.
